shots.description: Night rain chase: four cruisers on Rico's tail, explosions ahead, wanted 3 stars, raid danger zone on the minimap, a PD roadblock parked across the avenue ahead, DISPATCH dialogue
Ocean Drive at dusk in the rain — wet roads, glowing street lamps, Rico on foot by the beach, a live TAXI job with its cyan beacon on the Beach Motel, RICO dialogue
Payback standoff in the plaza — KING's ultimatum as a dialogue subtitle, the Kings in a ring with health bars, TONI of the crew standing at Rico's side, crew panel on the HUD
The Big Score closed out: the gold THE BIG SCORE results panel — $9,150 earned, RANK S — five stars, PD heli searchlight overhead, cruisers and an explosion behind the panel
